source: User-provided Kraken ETHUSD early trade profile ZIP; aggregated from local SQLite, not raw trades independently inspected

test.description: Exploratory 30-day trailing volume profile high/low-volume price bucket matched on price distance, both levels touched, neighboring events excluded, next-day close on opposite side of approach; no intraday sequence inference

limitations: Same-origin consistency not proof of raw trade completeness or independent deduplication.
Daily aggregation does not identify intraday sequence.
Early archive does not represent current liquidity.
No out-of-sample validation or probability calibration.
